open_points.subject: cross-service snapshots and the single-home rule
open_points.text: “Every other service ... reads that identity as a snapshot” and “no other service keeps a customer record or a copy of its values”
open_points.question: Does a snapshot mean a transient response only, or may a consumer persist it; if persistence is forbidden, when must the copy disappear?
options: transient in-memory use only
persistent snapshots without customer values
persistent snapshots allowed for named services
open_points.default_guess: Treat ordinary snapshots as transient and forbid persistence except for the expressly admitted documents and Portal projection.

open_points.subject: single-home guarantee
open_points.text: “Registry is the one home of a customer's personal data: no other service keeps a customer record or a copy of its values”
open_points.question: What action or acceptance condition establishes this promise, and what observable failure occurs if a consumer still stores a customer record or copied value?
options: production is blocked until every consumer migration is verified
the rule is contractual and tested in each consumer
Registry attempts runtime enforcement
open_points.default_guess: Make verified removal in every consumer a prerequisite for production acceptance.

open_points.subject: Client Portal offline projection
open_points.text: “except as fixed in a document it issued” versus “the one kept copy this rule admits besides issued documents”
open_points.question: Is Client Portal's offline projection an issued document covered by the Product statement's exception, or a separate exception that must be named there?
options: treat the projection as an issued publication document
add a separate Portal-projection exception
forbid the persisted projection
open_points.default_guess: Name it as a separate, narrowly bounded exception.

open_points.subject: external AI provider trust boundary
open_points.text: “Agent — any language-model agent acting for the owner”
open_points.question: Which external model provider, if any, receives the agent projection and other Registry-derived values, and what trust boundary applies to that transfer?
options: a local model receives them
named external providers receive them under their own terms
Kernel prevents Registry outputs from reaching any model provider
open_points.default_guess: Treat the configured external model provider as a separate recipient outside Registry's trust boundary and name it explicitly.

open_points.subject: customer name disclosure to PresuPro
open_points.text: “Name, phone, e-mail and language are all the customer's contact data” and “The customer's contact data reaches the owner alone” versus billing output “name, kind, tax id, legal name”
open_points.question: May PresuPro receive the customer's name when issuing a document, or is the name contact data restricted to the owner?
options: permit name as billing data
keep name owner-only and return only legal name
redefine contact data so name is not included
open_points.default_guess: Permit PresuPro to receive the name for document issuance and explicitly redefine the billing exception.

open_points.subject: object identifying characteristics
open_points.text: “the object's address and identifying characteristics are `personal_data`” but R0-80's single-home rule names only “the object's address”
open_points.question: May another service store a copy of an object's identifying characteristics, or does the same Registry-only storage rule that applies to its address apply to them too?
options: Registry-only for address and identifying characteristics
Registry-only for address; characteristics may be copied
named services may retain selected characteristics
open_points.default_guess: Apply the Registry-only rule to both address and identifying characteristics.

open_points.subject: full project card returned to services
open_points.text: “the project card ... with its object and rooms” for “a trusted service whose token allows `personal_data`” while “The customer's contact data reaches the owner alone”
open_points.question: Does a service's project-card response contain only the project's `customer_ref`, or does “project card” include the embedded Customer values shown on the owner's card?
options: service card contains only `customer_ref`
service card embeds billing data but not contact data
service card is identical to the owner's card
open_points.default_guess: Return only `customer_ref` to services; keep embedded Customer values exclusive to the owner interface.

open_points.subject: Portal projection contents
open_points.text: “it holds only what the customer's own cabinet shows, never a tax id”
open_points.question: Which exact personal values may the Client Portal offline projection persist, particularly customer name, contact data, project display name and object address?
options: only project ids and non-personal publication metadata
the project context including display name and object address
any values shown to that customer except tax id
open_points.default_guess: Allow only the explicitly enumerated customer-facing publication fields, excluding contact data, fiscal data and unrelated project data.

open_points.subject: fiscal-data authority
open_points.text: R0-37 says “fiscal data stays in PresuPro” while R0-80 says fiscal data is held only by Registry and “PresuPro keeps none” outside issued documents
open_points.question: Which service owns living tax ids and legal names?
options: Registry exclusively
PresuPro exclusively
Registry authoritative with a permitted PresuPro working copy
open_points.default_guess: Registry exclusively, with PresuPro retaining values only inside issued documents.

open_points.subject: issued-document exception
open_points.text: “A document a service issues ... fixes the values of its date”
open_points.question: What observable event makes a draft an issued document entitled to retain fixed personal values, and what happens if issuance fails or is cancelled?
options: successful finalisation assigns an immutable document identity and issue time
sending or publishing to the customer constitutes issuance
any saved document draft counts as issued
open_points.default_guess: Only successful finalisation with an immutable document identity and issue timestamp creates the retention exception.

open_points.subject: artifact pointers to documents containing personal data
open_points.text: The agent receives “artifact pointers,” while issued invoices, estimates and publications may contain fixed customer values and Registry “never reads or stores the payload”
open_points.question: Can a pointer exposed to an agent resolve to or authorize retrieval of an issued document containing personal data, and which component prevents that disclosure?
options: agent-visible pointers can never retrieve personal-data documents
the pointer is visible but the target service independently denies the agent
agents may retrieve such documents
open_points.default_guess: Require the target service to deny agent retrieval and ensure agent-visible pointers carry no retrieval capability for personal-data documents.

open_points.subject: customer erasure and surviving project links
open_points.text: R0-52 says “the personal data and the links that identify a person are removed,” while R0-67 says “projects keep naming” the erased Customer
open_points.question: After customer erasure, do projects retain `customer_ref`, or must that identifying link be removed?
options: retain the opaque `customer_ref`
remove the customer link from every project
retain it only when governance establishes that it cannot re-identify the person
open_points.default_guess: Retain `customer_ref` as R0-67 states, and explicitly narrow R0-52 accordingly.
